title: Deferred S3 upload optimizer for large tenant CSV exports (delta compression + staggered puts)
creator: Priya Nair
description:
Problem: Large multi-tenant CSV scheduled exports are causing high transient S3 PUT spikes and egress bursts during nightly windows. Customers that export many GBs at once are experiencing delayed deliveries (S3 throttling retries), elevated costs from small-object overhead, and occasional downstream consumer overload when all tenant payloads arrive simultaneously. Existing export pipeline produces full CSV snapshots for every scheduled run which increases upload volume and duplicate content across snapshots.

Goal: Reduce peak PUT rate and total upload throughput without increasing end-to-end latency for typical consumer workflows. Approach combines incremental delta compression, tenant-aware upload deferral windows, and staggered s3 PUT scheduling with grouped multipart uploads for large files.

Design summary:
- Delta generation: produce row-level delta CSVs for tenants that have <10% change since last snapshot. For tenants with large deltas fall back to full snapshot.
- Compression bundling: for many small-tenant exports (<50MB compressed) aggregate multiple tenant deltas into a single compressed archive (tar.gz) with a simple manifest to reduce PUT overhead and per-object cost.
- Deferred upload windows: add a tenant assignment algorithm that maps tenants to a short time slot (3-10 minute window) within the scheduled export period based on tenant priority and size, smoothing PUT QPS across the export window.
- Staggered multipart strategy: for large single-tenant files (>100MB) use multipart uploads with a controlled concurrency limiter and exponential backoff tuned for S3 error codes to avoid global retry storms.
- Metadata and manifest format: add a compact manifest.json alongside every bundle containing tenant id, original filename, compression format, checksum, and byte range pointers for in-bundle files to support resume and targeted re-downloads.

Non-goals: Change export file formats (we keep CSV), re-architect the delivery channel (still S3/webhooks), or change customer access patterns today.

Acceptance criteria, testing, and rollout are below.
acceptance_criteria: Reduce peak S3 PUT QPS across the nightly export window by >=60% for large customers compared to current baseline
Reduce outgoing bytes for tenants with <10% row churn by >=40% via delta snapshots and bundling
No regressions: scheduled export end-to-end success rate >=99.5% in staging and >=99.0% during first-week canary in prod
Support resumable bundle downloads using manifest metadata and multipart object ranges
Monitoring shows reduced 5xx S3 retry storms and fewer pipeline-level backpressure incidents
rollout_plan: 1) Feature flag gated: start with internal company-owned tenants in staging. 2) Canary: enable for 5 low-risk production tenants for 24h. 3) Gradually enroll medium & high-volume tenants grouped by account size over 2 weeks. 4) Fully enable on calendar-based scheduled exports after meeting success metrics. Rollback is immediate: flip feature flag to revert to full-snapshot path.
test_plan: Unit tests for delta detector, bundler, and manifest generator. Integration tests in staging that validate: checksum/resume behavior, bundle extraction, single-tenant large file multipart flows, and webhook consumer compatibility. Load test: synthetic 10k-tenant run to measure PUT QPS smoothing and cost delta. End-to-end canary in prod with tight alerting for P50/P95 export latency and success rate.
monitoring_and_alerts: Dashboards: export-throughput (bytes/sec), s3_put_qps_by_minute, bundle_size_distribution, failed_upload_rate, avg_export_latency_by_tenant. Alerts: s3_put_qps > baseline*1.2 for >5m (warn), failed_upload_rate > 0.5% for 10m (page), export_success_rate < 99% for 15m (page). Add logging for manifest mismatches and resumed_upload_counts.
comments: 2025-02-25 - Diego Ramos: Spike completed. Delta detector prototype reduces payload by ~48% on a 3-day sample. Observed new edge case where tenant schema drift causes row-id mismatch; added normalization step in pre-compare stage.

2025-02-28 - Priya Nair: Design review notes: prefer manifest as newline-delimited JSON to ease streaming parsing in downstream consumers. Add a compatibility layer that allows consumers to opt into bundled manifests via a header field in S3 object metadata.
2025-03-01 - Diego Ramos: Implemented bundling and deferred upload scheduler. Integration tests green locally. Started staging run against internal-export-qa tenancy group.

2025-03-03 - QA: Staging run results: peak PUT QPS down 62%, total bytes down 37% for mixed tenant set. Two failures observed where multipart upload parts timed out — tuning concurrency and part size in progress (PR #8493).
2025-03-04 - Diego Ramos: Enabled canary for 3 low-risk prod tenants at 02:00 UTC. Early telemetry looks good — will monitor full 24h cycle before wider rollout.
